entries.text: The Lameme are thriving: from 24 to 49 in 30 days.
The Lameta are gone, after 17 days on the island.
Among the Lameme, a group grew apart: the Lameha.
The last Lamepu died; the species lived here 5 months.
The last Lameku died; the species lived here 2 months.
The earth shook and the land shifted.
The Lameno are gone, after 3 months on the island.
The Lamenu are dwindling: from 44 to 14 in 30 days.
The Lamege are thriving: from 22 to 44 in 30 days.
